verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM ships workflows that run actions automatically, such as routing leads or updating fields when a deal closes. The insert-records API confirms that record events trigger these workflows, and Zia can generate workflows from natural language, which fits the AI-native persona. Field-level event notifications add event-driven hooks. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on workflow rule conditions and the range of action types, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
